full_judgment: 3. In the plaint the plaintiffs stated, inter alia that plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 and defendant No. 5 are the owners in possession of the suit land along with other lands appertainting to khatian No.114 of mouza Ullashwar, that plaintiff No.3 has been living on the land with her husband and children. In 1985 defendant No. 5 proposed to sell his portion and share in the ejmali property and the plaintiffs having agreed to purchase the same paid the consideration money to defendant No. 5 in presence of witnesses. Mention may be made that the lands in question are all homestead land. Having received the entire consideration money, defendant No. 5 executed and registeed 3 saf kabalas in favour of plaintiff No.1- 3 at the Laksham Sub-Registry Office on 8-2-86 and delivered possession of the suit land to the respective plaintiffs and since then they have been owning and possessing the suit land. The quantum of land purchased by the plaintiffs was 2.32 acres of land. Subsequently the plaintiffs came to know that the defendant Nos. 1-4 through false personation created 3 forged kabalas alleged to have been executed and registered by defendant No.5 in respect of 1.57 acres of land from the very same land which they purchased from defendant No. 5. It is further stated that defendant No. 5 never executed and registered those deeds in favour of defendant Nos. 1-4.
